# Pinned Python dependency constraints for WeasyPrint, generated by running
# `pip3 freeze` inside the built image. PyPI never removes published
# versions, so — unlike the apt package pins in the Dockerfile — pinning
# these here is safe: it will not break a future build when a mirror rotates
# old versions out.
#
# What this pin buys is WeasyPrint's own version, which decides layout.
#
# It used to be justified by fontTools instead, on the grounds that fontTools
# subsets and embeds the fonts. That stopped being true when libharfbuzz-subset0
# was added to the image: WeasyPrint subsets with HarfBuzz whenever it is present
# and only falls back to fontTools when it is not. The subsetter is now an apt
# package, unpinned like the fonts, for the reasons given in the Dockerfile.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint sh app -c 'pip3 freeze'
# and review the diff before committing.
brotli==1.2.0
cffi==2.1.1
cssselect2==0.10.1
fonttools==4.66.0
pillow==12.3.0
pycparser==3.0
pydyf==0.12.1
pyphen==0.18.1
tinycss2==1.5.1
tinyhtml5==2.1.0
weasyprint==70.0
webencodings==0.6.1
zopfli==0.4.3
